description: Add a catalogue line or reprice one: a code, a name, a unit, an optional VAT rate, and price_minor in whole minor units for one currency, tier and valid_from. A repriced line keeps its old rows. Free: 25 SKUs, one tier.

currency.description: ISO code this price is in. Defaults to the shared business profile's currency

duplicate_ok.description: Add it even though another code already carries the same product at the same price. Default false

name.description: What it is on the customer's document, e.g. Website audit

price_minor.description: The price of ONE, in whole minor units. 45000 is EUR 450.00. Never a decimal

sku.description: The code, e.g. WEB-AUDIT. Upper case, no spaces. This is what an invoice line is filed under

tier.description: Price tier, e.g. trade or list. Default standard. A second tier is Pro

unit.description: What one of it is: each, hour, month, 1000 words. Default each. Required the first time

valid_from.description: The first day this price applies, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today

vat_rate.description: VAT percent for this product, overriding the shared profile's default on a resolved line

name: sku_set
title: Add or reprice a SKU
